access: Full AP article text returned through the web research layer; direct curl was not used as primary evidence.
passages: AP reported on September 10 that Governor Gavin Newsom signed a package of child online-safety laws, including a law requiring companion-chatbot operators to perform risk assessments and implement specified safety measures.
AP reported from the signing event that the chatbot measure was inspired by Adam Raine's story and quoted his mother, Maria Raine, saying parents had not understood the dangers of AI companionship.
AP separately reported Meta's objection to the addictive-feed restriction; it did not attribute that objection specifically to SB 1119's chatbot provisions.
limitation: AP independently confirms the signing and public context. The enrolled bill text, not AP's summary, governs the candidate's descriptions of operative dates, duties and exceptions.
